areas.name: Sunset North
areas.blurb:
The northern stretch of the sandstone cliff line along the west brow of Lookout Mountain above Chattanooga, widely regarded as the birthplace of the city's climbing. Traditional routes dominate, from 5.4 to the 5.13s with most at 5.10 and 5.11, and many can be led or top-roped.

The rock is high-quality sandstone and the cliff sits in shade for most of the day, so it is chilly in winter and comfortable in summer. It suits trad climbers of every level and beginners after top-rope laps.
areas.approach: From the rim parking, a short walk of about five minutes leads along the brow to the base of the main overlook buttress and the cliff line to its north.
areas.parking_note: Drive up Lookout Mountain to West Brow Road at the rim, where the small lot holds only a handful of cars and has a short time limit. If it is full, park lower down at the climbers' lot or near the Cravens House rather than on the street.
